fresh_inline_findings.allegation: Resident workspace aliases reach scoped capture without canonical admission.
fresh_inline_findings.claim_scope: Finite source trace of the alleged public resident-hook path; no claim that every possible private direct caller is an authenticated ingress.
fresh_inline_findings.reason: Resolving a different parent during each capture would defeat rejection of a canonical workspace replaced after admission.
fresh_inline_findings.source_review: The public server calls _validated_hook_directory_string before policy preparation and worker dispatch; _validate_hook_directory_path applies realpath and root checks. Both fast worker and compatibility process receive the resulting canonical workspace. The internal coerce_resident_hook_request preserves this already admitted path. The independent direct installed probe had bypassed that admission; the local probe-only correction is retained separately.
